name: ai-context-mapping
description: Project map, negative invariants, and checks an agent cannot talk its way around: an invariant check after every Python edit, a commit gate, an MCP server for the map, an opt-in map gate, and a skill that installs the framework in your project.

map_gate.title: Map gate (enforce Rule 1)
map_gate.description: Block Grep, Glob, and search commands until the agent has read maps/project-map.md in this session. Does nothing in projects without a map.

python_command.title: Python command
python_command.description: Command that starts Python 3.9 or newer, used for the MCP server. On Windows, python3 often opens the Microsoft Store; use python or py there.
